This means that for each color, you should consider the minimum deliciousness value of beans of that color and then choose the color where this minimum is as large as possible.
fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions:
The flawed specification is incorrectly focused on finding the maximum deliciousness value for each color and then determining the overall maximum among these values. 1. Track the minimum deliciousness value for each color instead of the maximum.
2. Determine the maximum among these minimum values to achieve the desired outcome.
